cleanup.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this generated plant sprite. Preserve the actual painted vegetation, shapes, blue-teal shadows and yellow-green sunlight. Remove ALL surrounding soft green glow, colored haze, gradient fog and black background. ONLY real leaves, blades and stems may have alpha; the empty space around them and between blades must be fully transparent alpha=0, crisp cutout edges with only a very thin antialiased edge. No semi-transparent colored halo. Shrink the complete plant slightly if needed so there is at least 7% EMPTY transparent padding at every frame edge. The result is one intact clean transparent RGBA game sprite, not a scene or sticker, no solid background, no white outlines. Preserve the style and full botanical silhouette; no added objects or text.
